environment.description: Spring Boot 3.1 application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an AWS ALB with default listener rules. No request body inspection is configured. The ALB simply forwards HTTPS traffic to the target group on port 8080. Security groups allow inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB and ALB-to-ECS on 8080. No additional middleware or request filtering is present.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with default HTTPS listener, no WAF attached
config.network: Public ALB -> private subnet ECS tasks
